notes.title: Patch 1.1.1: Garden of Secrets – Community Feedback
notes.notes:
[b]We truly appreciate your feedback! This update includes several adjustments based on your suggestions. If you have any more comments after playing, feel free to share them![/b]

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] Some notes have been rewritten to improve clarity based on recent feedback, including note 27 and the garden pedestal plaques.

[*] Additional hints have been added to the garden workshop.

[*] The Punch cards puzzle restart process has been improved for better clarity.

[*] Minor text corrections.
[/list]

[b]BUGS[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the Greenhouse puzzle reset.

[*] Other minor bugs have been resolved.
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0: Garden of Secrets
notes.notes:
[b]Have you escaped the Waterfall Tower, but your adventure is far from over.[/b]

Get ready for [i]Patch 1.1.0: Garden of Secrets[/i]! A whole new area is now available to explore, packed with exciting puzzles, hidden items, and mysterious secrets. Along with this new content, we’ve made various fixes and improvements to enhance your experience.

Accessing the new area is simple: just complete the game and unlock the Epilogue. Then, continue your journey and dive into the unknown!

The [i]Garden of Secrets[/i] awaits—more challenges, more rewards, and endless mysteries to uncover.

Enjoy the adventure!

[previewyoutube=LNDVhVh8PYs;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*]  The camera in the *Shelf book puzzle* has been fixed.
[*] Minor text corrections have been made in [Catalan, English].
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] The *Computer levers puzzle* has been fixed.
[*] Other minor bugs have been resolved.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.1 is now available, addressing several issues that were discovered during the first week of release.

[b]BUGS[/b]
[list]
[*] Demo to Full Game Compatibility Issue: In some cases, when switching from the demo to the full game, the next room wouldn't load, leaving players trapped in the Catacombs. This issue has been resolved, allowing players to retry the puzzle to exit the Catacombs if needed.

[*] Some notes are now easiest to pick up.

[*] Minor corrections have been made to certain texts.

[*] The initial video error on SteamDeck has been fixed.

[*] An incorrect achievement was mistakenly granted when collecting all the notes; in fact, an extra achievement was awarded by mistake.

[*] Other minor bugs have been resolved.

[/list]

notes.title: Waterfall Prisoner is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[i]You awaken in a damp cell, located in the deepest basement of the mysterious Waterfall Tower.

In making your way out, you discover you weren't the first in this predicament, someone preceded you - and they left behind hints that might help you abscond before the night is over.
[/i]
[previewyoutube=dIEAQdCo_WQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Can you escape from Waterfall Tower? [/b]
A puzzle-focused escape room game, made in the vein of the classic graphic adventures of old.

I hope you enjoy it!!

notes.title: Waterfall Prisoner Demo Update
notes.notes:
[b]
I am pleased to announce that the Waterfall Prisoner demo has been updated 
[/b]

[previewyoutube=3kUWIrLsFSs;full][/previewyoutube]

After the Summer 2023 edition of Steam Next Fest, I received a lot of very interesting feedback and many requests regarding accessibility and game quality. Thank you very much for taking the time to share your opinions!

Features such as quick object inspection, Field of View adjustment, and more tweaks are now available.

I hope they will be useful for the final version of the game! 
If you have any comments, don't hesitate to share them! Your feedback is highly valuable!
